Record Class SecurityPositionSeries.Event

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.SecurityPositionSeries.Event
Record Components:
date - business date of the transaction
idSecurityaccount - the security account
type - the transaction type
idTransaction - the transaction
idSecurityTransfer - the security transfer the transaction belongs to, null for an ordinary transaction
units - units of the transaction, null for one without units
unitsAfter - units of the account after the transaction, on the split basis of the report date
costBaseBefore - cost basis of the account before the transaction
costBaseAfter - cost basis of the account after the transaction
flowSC - change of the position flow: positive into the position, negative out of it
incomeSC - change of the income of the account
gainLoss - realized result of a sale, 0 for other types
costBaseRemoved - cost a sale removed from the cost basis, 0 for other types
consumedLots - lots a FIFO or LIFO sale consumed, null otherwise
bookedRate - rate into the main currency known from the transaction itself, 1 for a security in the main currency; null when the rate of the point applies
marginPositions - for a margin instrument the open positions of the account after the transaction, null for any other security. Margin events carry the result of an opening or a close in gainLoss and a finance cost in incomeSC; the cost basis and flow fields are not read.
marginOpening - whether the transaction opens a margin position
exDate - ex-date of a dividend, null when unknown or for other types. The price falls on the ex-date while the dividend is booked on its payment date, so the drawdown takes the outflow on the ex-date; income and results stay on the payment date.
Enclosing class:
SecurityPositionSeries
public static record SecurityPositionSeries.Event(LocalDate date, Integer idSecurityaccount, TransactionType type, Integer idTransaction, Integer idSecurityTransfer, Double units, double unitsAfter, double costBaseBefore, double costBaseAfter, double flowSC, double incomeSC, double gainLoss, double costBaseRemoved, List<SecurityPositionSeries.ConsumedLot> consumedLots, Double bookedRate, List<SecurityPositionSeries.MarginPosition> marginPositions, boolean marginOpening, LocalDate exDate) extends Record
One transaction of the replay, captured right after it was processed. The account values are the state of the account's summary after the transaction; the deltas are its changes caused by the transaction.
